description: This file defines the interface for the Grapher control class within the GraphControl namespace. It includes event declarations, properties for graph configuration, methods for graph manipulation, and internal state management. It also references multiple external models and utilities related to graphing, equations, and rendering.

classes.name: Grapher
classes.description: A sealed class representing a graph plotting control for rendering mathematical equations, handling user interactions, and managing graph display properties within a UWP application.

methods.name: Grapher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Grapher control.

methods.name: ZoomFromCenter
methods.description: Zooms the graph view from the center by a specified scale factor.

methods.name: ResetGrid
methods.description: Resets the grid to its default state.

methods.name: SetVariable
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified variable in the graph context.

methods.name: ConvertToLinear
methods.description: Converts a MathML string to a linear format.

methods.name: FormatMathML
methods.description: Formats a MathML string for display.

methods.name: PlotGraph
methods.description: Draws or updates the graph based on current equations and settings.

methods.name: AnalyzeEquation
methods.description: Analyzes a given equation to extract features or properties.

methods.name: TryUpdateGraph
methods.description: Attempts to update the graph rendering, optionally keeping the current view.

methods.name: TryPlotGraph
methods.description: Attempts to plot the graph, with retry logic if needed.

methods.name: UpdateGraphOptions
methods.description: Updates graph options based on current equations.

methods.name: GetGraphableEquations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of equations suitable for graphing.

methods.name: SetGraphArgs
methods.description: Sets the internal graph object with provided graph data.

methods.name: GetGraph
methods.description: Retrieves the internal graph object associated with a specific equation.

methods.name: UpdateVariables
methods.description: Updates the variables used in the graph equations.

methods.name: ScaleRange
methods.description: Scales the view range centered at specified X and Y coordinates.

methods.name: OnCoreKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events for keyboard interactions.

methods.name: OnCoreKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key up events for keyboard interactions.

methods.name: UpdateTracingChanged
methods.description: Updates the tracing state and triggers related events.

methods.name: HandleTracingMovementTick
methods.description: Handles periodic updates for tracing movement.

methods.name: HandleKey
methods.description: Handles specific key press or release actions.

methods.name: SetEquationsAsValid
methods.description: Marks current equations as valid for graphing.

methods.name: SetEquationErrors
methods.description: Sets error states for equations if invalid.

methods.name: TryInitializeGraph
methods.description: Attempts to initialize the graph with current equations and settings.
